changes.title: Chart prebuild
items: The map table and the sea chart open at once after the first time: every island is made once and kept

changes.title: Scenery shadow taper
items: Scenery's shadows taper at the base like the trees' do, wider pieces opening out over more ground

changes.title: Runestone shadow fade
items: Runestones', soundsystems' and ruins' shadows fade in softly at their base instead of starting hard
